title: 1Password coordinate data
description: Shape of .chezmoidata/secrets.yaml. Merged into the same template data as hosts.yaml. Names a vault and the items templates read; it cannot tell whether either exists, since only `op` knows that.

vault.description: Default 1Password vault. An item may override it with its own `vault`.

items.description: Short key -> item coordinates. The key is what templates write (.secrets.items.slskd); a hyphenated key needs `index`. A typo is caught at render time by missingkey=error.

vault.description: Vault holding this item, overriding the top-level default. A non-ASCII vault name works with onepassword/onepasswordItemFields/onepasswordDetailsFields, but an op:// secret reference rejects it ("invalid character in secret reference").
